activities.whenToUse: Use when an item graph and configured EmitEntries plan token should run the telemetry preparation/conduction path. The branch looks for a stored TelemetryHandled_EmitEntries result and can forward it even if conduction fails; this can emit provider telemetry.

activities.name: SendMessage
activities.whenToUse: Use when Plan.Path identifies nonempty JSON text through Token.Memory/Get and Config.CountKey names an item graph entry for its exact outbound object-envelope count. The branch stores that count before posting the unchanged body and returns the raw REST receipt.
activities.description: Count outbound JSON envelopes on the item graph, post the unchanged body, and return the raw REST receipt.

properties.description: Read Config.CountKey to store the submitted envelope count on the current item graph before POST.
properties.whenToUse: Supply Config.CountKey for SendMessage; it is read after the body has been resolved and parsed, and the item graph must exist before POST.

properties.description: Provide the content lookup path forwarded to Token.Memory/Get to obtain the message body.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the content lookup path forwarded to Token.Memory/Get. SendMessage requires the result to be nonempty JSON text representing one object or a nonempty array of objects; the body is posted unchanged.

properties.description: Item graph key for the count parsed from the exact outbound JSON body before POST.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a nonblank item graph key for the count parsed from the exact outbound JSON body. The provider registers that count before its REST POST; it is not inferred from the response.

result.description: When nonempty JSON telemetry body and CountKey supplied; REST POST returns (Result presence conditional).

activities.name: HandleResponse
activities.whenToUse: Use to normalize a raw telemetry REST response locally, without a provider request. It validates Config.RawResponse and Config.ItemsSent, stores {ItemsReceived, ItemsAccepted, Result} at Config.HandledResultKey, then logs any service errors; Result is accepted==sent even if the Signal fails on errors.
activities.description: Provider-free normalization of Config.RawResponse and Config.ItemsSent into { ItemsReceived, ItemsAccepted, Result }; Result is exactly ItemsAccepted == ItemsSent regardless of errors. Store at Config.HandledResultKey before LogCritical per error; a count match with errors retains Result true in a failed Signal.

properties.description: Raw REST response property bag or JSON object from the matching SendMessage Key.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a raw REST response property bag or JSON object from the matching SendMessage request. HandleResponse requires receipt counts and validates optional errors before normalization.

properties.description: Positive whole item count from the matching SendMessage CountKey; never inferred from service counts.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the positive whole item count saved from the matching SendMessage CountKey. It is not inferred from service counts; normalization requires accepted<=received<=sent.

properties.description: Distinct item graph key for the normalized result, including on reported service errors.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a distinct nonblank item graph key for the normalized result. The provider stores it before logging any reported service errors, so a failed Signal may still contain the stored Result.

result.description: parsed receipt count [provider-returned]. When raw response property bag, ItemsSent and HandledResultKey; counts valid and no error entries.
parsed receipt count [provider-returned]. When raw response property bag, ItemsSent and HandledResultKey; counts valid and no error entries.
accepted equals sent; may be false without Signal failure [computed]. When raw response property bag, ItemsSent and HandledResultKey; counts valid and no error entries.

resultNotes: Satellite_AzureApplicationInsights: failed Signal can retain PSCustomObject Result (counts valid but errors array has entries); inspect detailed contract and mapped exposure before use.
Satellite_AzureApplicationInsights: False business Result alone does not fail Signal; errors do
